label: HTTP Client: Send Request
command: script="${HTTP_CLIENT_EXTENSION_DIR:-$HOME/Library/Application Support/Zed/extensions/installed/http-client}/scripts/zed-rest-client.mjs"; if [ ! -f "$script" ]; then script="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/zed/extensions/installed/http-client/scripts/zed-rest-client.mjs"; fi; if [ ! -f "$script" ]; then echo "HTTP Client runner not found. Set HTTP_CLIENT_EXTENSION_DIR to the extension root." >&2; exit 1; fi; node "$script" send --file "$ZED_FILE" --line "$ZED_ROW" --cwd "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT"

label: HTTP Client: Copy Request as cURL
command: script="${HTTP_CLIENT_EXTENSION_DIR:-$HOME/Library/Application Support/Zed/extensions/installed/http-client}/scripts/zed-rest-client.mjs"; if [ ! -f "$script" ]; then script="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/zed/extensions/installed/http-client/scripts/zed-rest-client.mjs"; fi; if [ ! -f "$script" ]; then echo "HTTP Client runner not found. Set HTTP_CLIENT_EXTENSION_DIR to the extension root." >&2; exit 1; fi; node "$script" copy-curl --file "$ZED_FILE" --line "$ZED_ROW" --cwd "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT"
